_note: DECLARED navigation model for the book's cartographic layer (round-7 Thrust B). The Part SEQUENCE and full titles are NOT stored here — they are read from build_book._PART_TITLES at projection time (single source of truth, renumber-safe), exactly as the outcomes model reads it. This file holds only the per-Part facts the sequence cannot carry: a short SUBWAY_LABEL (the station name on the book-level map, an abbreviation of the full title), the NEW_HERE_VOCAB (terms first deployed in that Part), and the CARRYING_FORWARD (the author-CURATED 5-8 MOST load-bearing PRIOR terms this Part builds on — NOT the full cumulative lexicon; every entry must appear in an earlier Part's new_here_vocab). CONSUMERS: (1) book-models/nav_map_model.py projects assets/nav-subway-p{1..6}.svg (book-level 'where am I in the book?' map, one highlight variant per Part). The former Part-local map family (assets/nav-local-p{1..6}.svg, driven by the now-removed LOCAL_NODES field) was retired in the round-7 opener-anatomy change and deleted in W4 cleanup — the opener keeps only the subway map. (2) book/book_typst.py reads new_here_vocab + carrying_forward to render the Part-opener verso VOCAB BLOCK natively ('Carrying forward' capped-prior band + 'New here' this-Part band), the sole local-orientation device on the leaner verso. Hand-authored SOURCE. See scratchpad/theory-book-restructure/GLOSSARY-AND-MAPS-RATIFIED-PLAN.md §1. The Part-4 lean-4 (Workflow/Migration/Validation/Skills) matches round-6; carrying_forward sets are a W3 curation flagged for author eyeball at W4.
